atrial fibrillation and flutter: same scope
other chronic obstructive pulmonary disease: same scope
asthma: CM J45 also holds status asthmaticus (WHO J46): WHO J45 is inside CM J45
other interstitial pulmonary diseases: same scope
fibrosis and cirrhosis of liver: same scope
